description: Acidentes de Trânsito - Acidentes is a dataset listed in City of Porto Alegre open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by EPTC. Registro de acidentes no município de Porto Alegre, tipificados de acordo com existência ou não de pessoas feridas e vítimas fatais decorrentes do acidente de trânsito. Coverage: Porto Alegre. The portal files it under the publisher EPTC. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, PDF. The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-poa-portal.
